article_notes: B. rossi (PCR/RLB), 103 naturally infected dogs at the Onderstepoort hospital plus 5 experimentally infected Beagles. Naturally infected dogs are compared with healthy controls and with IMHA dogs (a disease comparator, not a severity group); no grouping of Babesia dogs by severity or outcome. The experimental low-dose vs high-dose groups are inoculum groups, reported descriptively per day with no test, and not a severity definition. Nothing extracted. Natural-infection cohorts overlap other Onderstepoort B. rossi studies (2013-2015 collection).
